package parser

import (
	"go.starlark.net/starlark"
	"go.starlark.net/starlarkstruct"
)

type Parser struct{}

// newParseTimeGlobals exercises the nested-module shape used by the
// `log` namespace (Phase 07.2.1). Combines a direct NewBuiltin
// registration (`flow`) with a *starlarkstruct.Module wrapping four
// member builtins (`log.info`, `log.warn`, `log.error`, `log.debug`).
func newParseTimeGlobals(p *Parser, thread *starlark.Thread) (starlark.StringDict, error) {
	g := starlark.StringDict{
		"flow": starlark.NewBuiltin("flow", p.builtinFlow),
		"log": &starlarkstruct.Module{
			Name: "log",
			Members: starlark.StringDict{
				"info":  starlark.NewBuiltin("log.info", p.builtinLogInfo),
				"warn":  starlark.NewBuiltin("log.warn", p.builtinLogWarn),
				"error": starlark.NewBuiltin("log.error", p.builtinLogError),
				"debug": starlark.NewBuiltin("log.debug", p.builtinLogDebug),
			},
		},
	}
	_ = thread
	return g, nil
}
